scope: Five new bounded pedagogic modules. No production execution and no causal effect claim.

modules.label: SG01
modules.title: 从订单展开为年龄 hazard 的实际拟合
modules.implemented: Actual order-separated time blocks, person-day construction, 11 age dummies, price/warehouse/promotion logistic fit, validation C selection, test Brier and age-only baseline.
modules.limits: Discrete logistic hazard, not Cox. Conditional independent censoring is a simulation assumption, not causal identification.

modules.label: SG02
modules.title: 24小时静默与受约束的裁剪和超卖
modules.implemented: 24h gate, lead-time mixture, net retention, BOM/late capacity, fixed-action costs, per-scenario shortfall risk and required supply for each commitment quantity.
modules.limits: Single-SKU fixed-policy scenario, no recourse value, no general APS/MRP or production actions. New added orders assumed same age/features for this exercise only.

modules.label: SG03
modules.title: 退货 GBDT 时滞回流与 ATP 采购分账
modules.implemented: Actual order-feature GBDT, mature 30-day labels, category good-yield and conditional lag, separate physical stock, firm inbound, order reservations, ATP and two procurement suggestions.
modules.limits: Single due-date ATP and expected-value planning. No risk-aware multiperiod ATP guarantee or supplier purchase.

modules.label: SG04
modules.title: COD 订单风险与有限人审状态机
modules.implemented: Address/hour/pieces/basket/history/region feature contract, actual logistic fit with separate calibration/threshold/test, review capacity, explicit confirm/deny/timeout/manual approval transitions and causal trial design.
modules.limits: Local scoring contract, not a real-time online service. No actual work orders or randomized intervention experiment. Assumed 30% risk reduction is not measured effect.

modules.label: SG05
modules.title: 交期波动敏感性与未完成 PO
modules.implemented: 12-cell variance/SS sensitivity; actual quantile GBDT on mature vintages with as-of WIP and receipt progress; next-receipt discrete hazard using censored episodes; pending partial receipts; OTD against promised dates; explicit support abstention. Strict seasonal/numeric support checks; stage-specific next-event elapsed support; separate pending-cohort future-only diagnostics.
modules.limits: No LightGBM/AFT. Mature-vintage full-completion quantile loss is not censor-aware. Separate censored next-event model does not remove that limitation. Raw full test P50 coverage 58.67% fails teaching calibration warning band.
